about: What townsfolk work toward (dungeon/world/townsfolk.py). text and period complete 'trying to ...' (period wording for towns before cars and phones); steps is how many good weeks it takes; practice is the place kind and part of day they go to work on it (see GOAL_KINDS), or null; progress and done lines start with {name}; interest is what a profile drafted from them lists; bio is their first-person line on a dating profile. Add goals freely; every id must be new.

goals.progress: {name} made a tricky contract with a new partner
goals.done: {name} plays at the club every week now
goals.bio: Learning bridge well enough for the club.

goals.text: make a stained glass panel
goals.period: make a leaded window of coloured glass
goals.progress: {name} cut a curve in the glass without cracking it
goals.done: {name} hung the panel in the window and the light pours through
goals.bio: Making a stained glass panel, one piece at a time.

goals.text: make the rowing crew
goals.period: make the rowing crew for the regatta
goals.progress: {name} kept stroke with the crew for a whole practice
goals.done: {name} rowed in the regatta with the crew
goals.bio: Training hard to make the rowing crew.

goals.text: get to know every neighbour on the street
goals.period: get to know every household on the lane
goals.progress: {name} brought biscuits to a neighbour they had never met
goals.done: {name} knows every neighbour by name and is invited everywhere
goals.bio: Getting to know every neighbour on my street.

goals.text: make a hat good enough to sell
goals.period: make a bonnet fine enough to sell
goals.progress: {name} blocked a hat that finally keeps its shape
goals.done: {name} sold their first hat to a stranger
goals.bio: Making a hat good enough to sell.

goals.text: plan a surprise party for their parents' anniversary
goals.period: plan a surprise feast for their parents' anniversary
goals.progress: {name} booked the room and kept the secret
goals.done: {name}'s surprise worked and their parents were teary and delighted
goals.bio: Secretly planning a surprise party for my parents' anniversary.

goals.text: plant a hundred trees
goals.period: plant a hundred trees on the common
goals.progress: {name} put another twenty saplings in the ground
goals.done: {name} planted tree number one hundred
goals.bio: Planting a hundred trees. Want to dig one?

goals.text: make a long walking pilgrimage
goals.period: walk the pilgrimage to a far shrine
goals.progress: {name} broke in boots on a long practice walk
goals.done: {name} completed the pilgrimage and came home quietly changed
goals.bio: Getting ready for a long walking pilgrimage.

goals.text: skate a full lap without falling
goals.period: skate the frozen pond without falling
goals.progress: {name} skated half a lap without grabbing the rail
goals.done: {name} glided a whole lap and nobody had to catch them
goals.bio: Trying to skate a full lap without falling.
